legend: Inna and Dima bought a table of size n × m in the shop. Each cell of the table contains a single letter: "D", "I", "M", "A".
Inna loves Dima, so she wants to go through his name as many times as possible as she moves through the table. For that, Inna acts as follows:
initially, Inna chooses some cell of the table where letter "D" is written;

then Inna can move to some side-adjacent table cell that contains letter "I"; then from this cell she can go to one of the side-adjacent table cells that contains the written letter "M"; then she can go to a side-adjacent cell that contains letter "A". Then Inna assumes that she has gone through her sweetheart's name;

Inna's next move can be going to one of the side-adjacent table cells that contains letter "D" and then walk on through name DIMA in the similar manner. Inna never skips a letter. So, from the letter "D" she always goes to the letter "I", from the letter "I" she always goes the to letter "M", from the letter "M" she always goes to the letter "A", and from the letter "A" she always goes to the letter "D".

Depending on the choice of the initial table cell, Inna can go through name DIMA either an infinite number of times or some positive finite number of times or she can't go through his name once. Help Inna find out what maximum number of times she can go through name DIMA.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 103).
Then follow n lines that describe Inna and Dima's table. Each line contains m characters. Each character is one of the following four characters: "D", "I", "M", "A".
Note that it is not guaranteed that the table contains at least one letter "D".
output: If Inna cannot go through name DIMA once, print on a single line "Poor Dima!" without the quotes. If there is the infinite number of names DIMA Inna can go through, print "Poor Inna!" without the quotes. Otherwise print a single integer — the maximum number of times Inna can go through name DIMA.
note: In the first test sample, Inna cannot go through name DIMA a single time.
In the second test sample, Inna can go through the infinite number of words DIMA. For that, she should move in the clockwise direction starting from the lower right corner.
In the third test sample the best strategy is to start from the cell in the upper left corner of the table. Starting from this cell, Inna can go through name DIMA four times.

legend.ai: Inna 和 Dima 在商店里买了一张大小为 n × m 的桌子。桌子的每个单元格中都包含一个字母：“D”、“I”、“M”或“A”。
Inna 喜欢 Dima，因此她希望在桌子中移动时，尽可能多次地走过他的名字。为此，Inna 按照以下方式行动：
最初，Inna 选择桌子中写有字母“D”的某个单元格；
然后 Inna 可以移动到某个边相邻的、包含字母“I”的表格格子；接着她可以从这个格子走到某个边相邻的、写有字母“M”的表格格子；然后她可以走到某个边相邻的、包含字母“A”的格子。此时 Inna 认为她已经走过了心上人的名字；
Inna 的下一步可以是走到某个边相邻的、包含字母“D”的表格格子，然后以类似的方式继续走完名字 DIMA。Inna 从不跳过字母。因此，从字母“D”她总是走到字母“I”，从字母“I”她总是走到字母“M”，从字母“M”她总是走到字母“A”，从字母“A”她总是走到字母“D”。
根据初始表格格子的选择不同，Inna 可以无限次地走过名字 DIMA，也可以走过有限的正数次，或者一次也无法走过他的名字。请帮助 Inna 求出她最多能走过名字 DIMA 多少次。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1≤n,m≤10^3）。
接下来有 n 行，描述 Inna 和 Dima 的表格。每行包含 m 个字符。每个字符是以下四种字符之一：“D”、“I”、“M”、“A”。
注意，不保证表格中至少包含一个字母“D”。

output.ai: 如果 Inna 一次也无法走出名字 DIMA，则输出一行 "Poor Dima!"（不含引号）。如果 Inna 可以走出无限多个名字 DIMA，则输出 "Poor Inna!"（不含引号）。否则输出一个整数——Inna 最多能走出名字 DIMA 的次数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Inna 一次也无法走出名字 DIMA。
在第二个样例中，Inna 可以走出无限多个名字 DIMA。为此，她应从右下角出发，沿顺时针方向移动。
在第三个样例中，最佳策略是从表格左上角的格子出发。从这个格子出发，Inna 可以走出四次名字 DIMA。
